description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) called EmployeeOnLeaveSearchFilterParams, used in the OrangeHRM system to handle filtering parameters for employee leave searches. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties and methods to manage filtering criteria such as date and accessible employee numbers, along with allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for encapsulating filtering parameters when searching for employees on leave, including date and accessible employee list, with predefined allowed sort fields.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date used for filtering employee leave records.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date used for filtering employee leave records.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the list of accessible employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: setAccessibleEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the list of accessible employee numbers for filtering.
